set.body: Deliver the user-facing spatial illusion that a Field can be re-expressed and subset across domains without evaluation. Descriptive operations such as to, in, rows, roi, slice, and time selection build one inspectable root-first plan. A terminal value or materialize operation resolves root data, compiles the complete root-to-final-target pullback once, loads only required source support where possible, applies at most one resampling step, memoizes safely, and preserves typed errors, QC, and provenance. Scope includes in-memory and external roots, affine and nonlinear mappings, volume and surface routes, compiler extensibility, JVM adapters, and JVM plus JS evidence. The completed spatial functor infrastructure epic remains the foundation; this epic owns the missing composable lazy experience.
set.title: Epic: Spatial lazy pull-through fields
